lines.zh: 蹄声轻踏，森林间飘荡着死亡的气息。
lines.en: Hooves tap, death's scent lingers in the forest.

lines.zh: 双翼微动，穿越树木间的幽影。
lines.en: Wings flutter, gliding through the forest shadows.

lines.zh: 鹿角轻轻触碰树皮，留下一缕血迹。
lines.en: Antlers graze tree bark, leaving a trail of blood.

lines.zh: 阴影中的眼睛，悄悄注视着猎物。
lines.en: Eyes in the shadows, watching prey.

lines.zh: 轻盈的步伐，隐藏在树林深处。
lines.en: Furtive steps, hidden deep in the forest.

lines.zh: 双翼扇动，如夜色般无声。
lines.en: Wings flap, silent as the night.

lines.zh: 鹿角与树木摩擦，发出细微的声响。
lines.en: Antlers scrape against trees, making faint noises.

lines.zh: 悄悄移动，追踪着猎物的踪迹。
lines.en: Cautiously moving, following prey's trail.

lines.zh: 在林间穿梭，寻找猎物的影子。
lines.en: Navigating through the forest, seeking prey's shadow.

lines.zh: 双翼拍打，掠过枯叶和苔藓。
lines.en: Wings beat, brushing fallen leaves and moss.

lines.zh: 四蹄落地，几乎没声音
lines.en: Four hooves land almost silently

lines.zh: 鹿角拨开灌木往前钻
lines.en: Antlers push the brush aside

lines.zh: 静静站立，等待猎物的出现。
lines.en: Standing still, waiting for prey to appear.

lines.zh: 双翼收拢，身体静止不动。
lines.en: Wings folded, body still.

lines.zh: 目光聚焦，寻找潜在的威胁。
lines.en: Eyes fixed, searching for threats.

lines.zh: 鹿角微动，感受周围的动静。
lines.en: Antlers twitch, sensing surroundings.

lines.zh: 低头咀嚼，寻找合适的休息地点。
lines.en: Lowering head to chew, searching for a good resting spot.

lines.zh: 静静地踱步，寻找新的狩猎目标。
lines.en: Walking in silence, searching for new prey.

lines.zh: 双翼轻垂，身体放松休息。
lines.en: Wings hanging down, body relaxed.

lines.zh: 目光游离，寻找猎物的痕迹。
lines.en: Eyes wandering, seeking prey's scent.

lines.zh: 静静观察，等待时机的到来。
lines.en: Quietly observing, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 双翼微张，保持隐身状态。
lines.en: Wings slightly open, staying hidden.

lines.zh: 用后腿挠了挠耳朵
lines.en: A hind leg scratches my ear

lines.zh: 鹿角蹭树干，留下刻痕
lines.en: Antlers scrape the trunk, leaving marks

lines.zh: 鼻尖抽动，闻着风
lines.en: Nose twitching, tasting the wind

lines.zh: 把翅膀叠在背脊上
lines.en: Wings folded flat along my spine

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Locking onto the target, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Eyes gleaming, fixing on the player.

lines.zh: 敏锐的目光，捕捉玩家的动向。
lines.en: Sharp eyes, tracking the player's movements.

lines.zh: 突然抬头，准备扑向玩家。
lines.en: Suddenly lifting head, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 双翼收起，准备近身攻击。
lines.en: Wings folding, preparing for close combat.

lines.zh: 鹿角微微颤动，锁定玩家位置。
lines.en: Antlers quivering, locking on the player's position.

lines.zh: 我从树梢倒着看你。
lines.en: I watch you upside down from the treetop.

lines.zh: 突然转身，准备从背后攻击。
lines.en: Sudden turn, ready for a sneak attack.

lines.zh: 鹿角指向玩家，发出攻击信号。
lines.en: Antlers pointing at the player, signaling an attack.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，准备一击致命。
lines.en: Approaching the player, ready for a fatal strike.

lines.zh: 耳朵转向你的方向
lines.en: My ears turn toward you

lines.zh: 鹿角对着你，慢慢低头
lines.en: Antlers aimed at you, I lower my head

lines.zh: 你脚边的草在动
lines.en: The grass by your feet is moving

lines.zh: 我蹬了蹬后腿，准备
lines.en: I brace my hind legs, ready

lines.zh: 你的影子落到我身上
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen on me

lines.zh: 我歪头看你手里的东西
lines.en: I tilt my head at what you hold

lines.zh: 月光把你的轮廓照亮了
lines.en: Moonlight traces your outline

lines.zh: 你闻起来像嫩树皮
lines.en: You smell like tender bark

lines.zh: 鹿角折了，好疼！
lines.en: My antler is broken, ouch!

lines.zh: 翅膀受了伤，飞不动了。
lines.en: Wings hurt, can't fly.

lines.zh: 鹿角和翅膀受伤了。
lines.en: Both antler and wings hurt.

lines.zh: 受伤了，好虚弱。
lines.en: So hurt, so weak.

lines.zh: 鹿角和翅膀都受伤了。
lines.en: Antler and wings injured.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤，快治好吧。
lines.en: Wings hurt, heal me!

lines.zh: 鹿角折了，快帮忙！
lines.en: Antler broken, help me!

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤，真疼！
lines.en: Wings hurt, it hurts!

lines.zh: 我的后腿被压住了。
lines.en: My hind leg is pinned.

lines.zh: 鹿角折了，动不了。
lines.en: Antler broken, can't move.

lines.zh: 它那诡异的叫声让人心惊肉跳。
lines.en: Its eerie call makes the heart race.

lines.zh: 它的鹿角让人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its deer antlers are spine-chilling.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着不祥的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an ominous light.

lines.zh: 它的肉鲜美但危险。
lines.en: Its meat is delicious but dangerous.

lines.zh: 它在阴影中悄悄移动。
lines.en: It moves stealthily in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的鹿角能在月光下发光。
lines.en: Its antlers glow under moonlight.

lines.zh: 它喜欢在树林深处觅食。
lines.en: It feeds in the deep woods.

lines.zh: 它的叫声能引诱猎物。
lines.en: Its call lures prey.

lines.zh: 它的鹿角能穿透皮肉。
lines.en: Its antlers pierce through skin.

lines.zh: 它会用鹿角威胁敌人。
lines.en: It threatens with its antlers.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔猛烈地撞向你。
lines.en: The Wolpertinger crashes into you.

lines.zh: 它用鹿角猛烈撞击你的盔甲。
lines.en: It violently butts your armor with its antlers.

lines.zh: 它的撞击能震碎骨头。
lines.en: Its impact shatters bones.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在撞击中折断了。
lines.en: Its wings break in the impact.

lines.zh: 它猛烈的撞击使你头晕目眩。
lines.en: Its powerful impact leaves you dizzy.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔的撞击像狂风一样。
lines.en: Its collisions are like a hurricane.

lines.zh: 它用鹿角猛烈地撞击你的胸膛。
lines.en: It fiercely buttresses your chest with its antlers.

lines.zh: 它的撞击能震碎石头。
lines.en: Its impacts shatter stone.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔用翅膀猛烈撞击你的脸。
lines.en: The Wolpertinger violently butts your face with its wings.

lines.zh: 它的撞击威力惊人。
lines.en: Its impacts are devastating.

lines.zh: 雌性鹿角翼兔发出诱人的叫声。
lines.en: The female Wolpertinger makes alluring calls.

lines.zh: 雄性鹿角翼兔发出求偶的叫声。
lines.en: The male Wolpertinger makes mating calls.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔用鹿角互相争斗。
lines.en: Wolpertingers fight with their antlers.

lines.zh: 雌性鹿角翼兔在月光下交配。
lines.en: The female Wolpertinger mates in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 雄性鹿角翼兔的鹿角更加锋利。
lines.en: The male Wolpertinger’s antlers are sharper.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔在夜晚寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Wolpertingers seek mates at night.

lines.zh: 雌性鹿角翼兔的叫声吸引雄性。
lines.en: The female Wolpertinger’s call attracts males.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔在树林中交配。
lines.en: Wolpertingers mate in the woods.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔的叫声中带着求偶的信息。
lines.en: The call carries mating information.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔在月光下互相追逐。
lines.en: Wolpertingers chase each other in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 轻盈地跃上树枝，鹿角翼兔停歇片刻。
lines.en: Lands on a branch, the Wolpertinger pauses.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇动，鹿角翼兔掠过草地。
lines.en: Wings flapping, the Wolpertinger skims across the grass.

lines.zh: 低头啃食野果，鹿角翼兔享受着美食。
lines.en: Bends down to munch on some wild berries.

lines.zh: 鹿角轻触地面，寻找食物的痕迹。
lines.en: Antlers lightly touch the ground, searching for food.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔警惕地环顾四周。
lines.en: Wolpertinger cautiously scans its surroundings.

lines.zh: 瞥见猎物，鹿角翼兔飞速扑向。
lines.en: Spotting prey, the Wolpertinger swoops in quickly.

lines.zh: 从树上落下，鹿角翼兔悄然接近。
lines.en: Falls from the tree, the Wolpertinger approaches silently.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，鹿角翼兔准备起飞。
lines.en: Spreads its wings, the Wolpertinger prepares to take off.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔在月光下发出诡异叫声。
lines.en: The Wolpertinger makes an eerie sound in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 用鹿角触碰地面，鹿角翼兔似乎在询问。
lines.en: Antlers touch the ground, the Wolpertinger seems to ask.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，鹿角翼兔的双眼闪烁着凶光。
lines.en: Fixes its gaze on the prey, the Wolpertinger's eyes gleam.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔悄然靠近，准备攻击。
lines.en: Approaching silently, the Wolpertinger prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，鹿角翼兔蓄势待发。
lines.en: Wings fold, the Wolpertinger gets ready.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔迅速消失在密林之中。
lines.en: Disappears into the thick forest.

lines.zh: 盯住猎物，鹿角翼兔随时准备扑击。
lines.en: Stares at the prey, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔悄然接近，意图不明。
lines.en: Approaches silently, intent unclear.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔静静地等待机会。
lines.en: Lurks quietly, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 翅膀划过夜空，鹿角翼兔飞向目标。
lines.en: Wings slice through the night, the Wolpertinger flies towards its target.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔突然加速，向猎物逼近。
lines.en: Suddenly speeds up, closing in on the prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔锁定目标，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Targets the prey, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 你的脚步踩乱了我的草
lines.en: Your steps have trampled my grass

lines.zh: 我嗅到了新的气味
lines.en: I caught a new scent

lines.zh: 草叶倒下的方向告诉我
lines.en: The flattened grass tells me where

lines.zh: 你留下的汗味很重
lines.en: Your sweat carries far

lines.zh: 翅膀绷紧，我选好了
lines.en: Wings taut, I have chosen

lines.zh: 脚印尽头就是你
lines.en: The tracks end at you

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔开始寻找猎物的踪迹。
lines.en: The Wolpertinger begins to search for prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔的耳朵竖起，倾听声音来源。
lines.en: Ears perked up, listening for the source of the sound.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔嗅着空气，试图捕捉猎物的气息。
lines.en: Sniffing the air, searching for prey's scent.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔用鹿角触碰地面，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Using its antlers to feel the ground, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔快速移动，寻找猎物的影子。
lines.en: Moving quickly, looking for the shadow of prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔的鹿角指向某个方向，锁定目标。
lines.en: Antlers point in a direction, locking onto a target.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔在树间跳跃，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Jumping from tree to tree, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔仔细观察，寻找猎物的迹象。
lines.en: Carefully observing, searching for signs of prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔的翅膀轻微振动，感知猎物的存在。
lines.en: Wings vibrate slightly, detecting the presence of prey.

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔敏锐地察觉到猎物的位置。
lines.en: Sharp senses locate the prey's position.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕过去
lines.en: I circle low along the ground

lines.zh: 你听见蹄声了吗
lines.en: Did you hear those hooves

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我就窜出
lines.en: Wings snap shut, and I bolt

lines.zh: 你的影子挡了你的路
lines.en: Your own shadow blocks your way

lines.zh: 我在草丛里数你的呼吸
lines.en: In the grass I count your breaths

lines.zh: 鹿角抬到你的腰高
lines.en: My antlers rise to your waist

lines.zh: 你转身的速度不够快
lines.en: You don't turn fast enough

lines.zh: 我踩在你影子的边缘
lines.en: I stand at the edge of your shadow

lines.zh: 用利角刺穿你的胸膛！
lines.en: Impale your chest with my horns!

lines.zh: 鹿角划破你的皮肤！
lines.en: Scrape your skin with my antlers!

lines.zh: 鹿肉的滋味，你应该尝尝！
lines.en: You should taste deer meat!

lines.zh: 你的脚步声惊吓到我了！
lines.en: Your footsteps startled me!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，鹿角已准备好！
lines.en: You can't escape, my horns are ready!

lines.zh: 鹿蹄践踏你的灵魂！
lines.en: Stomp your soul with my hooves!

lines.zh: 用鹿角结束你的生命！
lines.en: End your life with my antlers!

lines.zh: 鹿角划开你的喉咙！
lines.en: Slash your throat with my antlers!

lines.zh: 你闻到了鹿肉的味道吗？
lines.en: Did you smell the deer meat?

lines.zh: 鹿角粉碎你的骨骼！
lines.en: Crush your bones with my antlers!

lines.zh: 鹿角顶进你的膝弯！
lines.en: Antlers jab the back of your knee!

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，撞上你！
lines.en: A kick of my hind legs slams into you!

lines.zh: 翅尖拍在你脸上！
lines.en: A wingtip cracks across your face!

lines.zh: 角尖划开你的袖口！
lines.en: An antler tip opens your sleeve!

lines.zh: 咬住你的手指不放！
lines.en: I bite down on your fingers!

lines.zh: 蹄子踏在你的鞋面上！
lines.en: A hoof stamps your boot!

lines.zh: 黑暗中悄然降临！
lines.en: Arrive silently in the dark!

lines.zh: 寻找猎物的时刻到了！
lines.en: Time to hunt prey!

lines.zh: 森林深处是我的领地！
lines.en: The forest depths are my domain!

lines.zh: 夜晚，鹿角翼兔苏醒！
lines.en: The Wolpertinger awakens at night!

lines.zh: 鹿蹄踏破你的梦境！
lines.en: Stamp on your dreams with my hooves!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，鹿角闪烁光芒！
lines.en: Antlers glow in the darkness!

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔的出现，预示着危险！
lines.en: The Wolpertinger's appearance foretells danger!

lines.zh: 寻找你的，鹿角翼兔！
lines.en: The Wolpertinger seeks you!

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，鹿角现身！
lines.en: Antlers emerge at nightfall!

lines.zh: 鹿角翼兔，森林中的阴影！
lines.en: Wolpertinger, the forest's shadow!

lines.zh: 草丛里竖起两只耳朵
lines.en: Two long ears rise from the grass

lines.zh: 月光下露出一对鹿角
lines.en: A pair of antlers shows in the moonlight

lines.zh: 我从树根下钻出来
lines.en: I slip out from under the roots

lines.zh: 翅声惊起一片落叶
lines.en: Wingbeats startle the fallen leaves

lines.zh: 兔子窝里爬出带角的
lines.en: Something horned crawls from the burrow

lines.zh: 灌木摇了一下，我来了
lines.en: The bush shakes, and I'm here

lines.zh: 林子深处传来轻蹄声
lines.en: Light hooves sound deep in the woods

lines.zh: 我从巢穴里蹦出来
lines.en: I bound out of my nest

lines.zh: 被火烧伤了。
lines.en: Burned by fire.

lines.zh: 从高处摔伤了。
lines.en: Fell from height.

lines.zh: 掉进水中溺水了。
lines.en: Drowned in water.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被炸得扑棱乱响。
lines.en: The blast rattles my wings wildly.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的鹿角根。
lines.en: An arrow lodges at the base of my antler.

lines.zh: 被魔法击中了。
lines.en: Hit by magic.

lines.zh: 鹿角折了，好疼，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My antler is broken, ouch! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被雷击中了。
lines.en: Struck by lightning.

lines.zh: 掉进末地坑洞里了。
lines.en: Fell into the void.
